Military (2024)

This 700-square-foot addition transforms a single-family residence with a bespoke kitchen, a soaring double-height living area, and a lofted office that redefine spatial elegance. The design enhances airiness and sophistication, seamlessly blending function with a refined, modern aesthetic

Kelton (2022)

This 800-square-foot addition transforms the home into a refined modern farmhouse, where sleek standing seam metal roofing and wall panels harmonize with warm wood canopies for a striking yet inviting exterior. Inside, a bespoke modern kitchen, a dramatic double-height primary suite with a spacious walk-in closet, and a lofted office overlooking the bedroom create a perfect balance of luxury and contemporary comfort.

Norma (2022)

This 500-square-foot addition seamlessly expands the living space, introducing a bespoke bedroom with a walk-in closet and a spa-like, oversized bathroom. A bold new exterior, featuring board-formed concrete, sleek metal wall panels, minimalist geometries, and enlarged windows, redefines the home’s modern presence with refined sophistication.

Tahoe (2023)

This elegant, modern 4,000-square-foot lakefront residence is a masterful blend of warmth and industry, with a rich wood-clad façade and an exposed steel structure that exudes refined strength. Uninterrupted 270-degree views immerse the home in the serene embrace of towering pine canopies and the ever-changing expanse of the lake.

Trinidad (2024)

This 2,000-square-foot interior remodel redefines the home with a bespoke modern farmhouse kitchen, a luxurious primary suite with a sprawling walk-in closet and spa-like bathroom, and thoughtfully reimagined cozy bedrooms. The renovation infuses the space with essential light and openness, creating a perfect balance of warmth and modern elegance.

Cynthia (2020)

This stylish duplex in the heart of West Hollywood offers two distinct living experiences: one unit features a classic two-bedroom, two-bath layout, while the other reimagines modern living as a lofted, open-concept entertainment hub. Designed for versatility, the residence seamlessly blends comfort with an elevated social atmosphere.
